open_pair_consequences.nets: pin 30 (REGEN_ENABLE, D-BC-RG EN) - pin 17 (CHG_FCCEIL), both push-pull
open_pair_consequences.consequence: outputs equal: no current. Outputs opposite: 41.2 mA through both drivers (wires 13.0 mOhm), 68 mW in each; the EN net sits at 1.647 V (with the 10 kOhm EN bodge), above VEN_R max 1.4 V, so D-BC-RG turns on, and pin 17 reads HIGH. The REGEN switch is ON whenever pin 30 OR pin 17 is HIGH (pin 17 HIGH while pin 30 commands OFF closes REGEN); U121 RGN_ON (trip 1.75-1.88 V) reads OFF at 1.65 V
open_pair_consequences.detector: none in service: the closed REGEN is not proven by U121 at 1.65 V; T-F-12 tap-to-tap check before power-up

open_pair_consequences.consequence: pin 17 HIGH: no current. pin 17 LOW: the driver sinks the 3V3 rail through 12.3 mOhm of wire, 82.5 mA and 272 mW in the driver (rating TODO(verify: i.MX RT1062 datasheet); Teensy 3V3 regulator load TODO(verify: PJRC)); the node stays at the rail, so CHG_FCCEIL reads HIGH ('FC ceiling confirmed') whatever pin 17 commands
open_pair_consequences.detector: none in service (no FCCEIL readback); T-F-12 tap-to-tap check before power-up

open_pair_consequences.nets: BQ29200 OUT (BAL-NOK) - INA253 BT output / pin 41 / U104 IN- (via R140)
open_pair_consequences.consequence: no OV: OUT is low and sinks 30-85 uA at 0.05 V; the INA253 output (0.1 V/A x I_BT) overrides it, so pin 41 reads the BT current (error <= the sink current into the INA253 output) and N_BAL (via R178) follows the INA253 level, LOW below the U123 threshold: OVN correct. Pack OV: OUT sources >= 100 uA at 1.75 V and up to 8 mA into a short, against the INA253 output, which INA253A1IPWR.pdf Figure 14 characterises only to 7 mA: either the INA253 holds the node near its own level, so N_BAL stays LOW and the BQ29200 pack-OV term (OVN) is MASKED while the pack is over voltage, or OUT lifts the node toward its 6.0-9.5 V drive level (at VDD 10 V) and drives pin 41 above its 3.3 V supply through the pad clamp
open_pair_consequences.detector: none in service for the masked OVN (it appears only at a pack OV); T-A-01c and the T-F-12 tap-to-tap check before power-up

open_pair_consequences.nets: INA253 BT output / pin 41 - GND Kelvin (SNS-BT pad 15)
open_pair_consequences.consequence: the INA253 output drives a short to the Kelvin GND (current limit not in INA253A1IPWR.pdf; Figure 14 ends at 7 mA); pin 41 and U104 IN- read 0 A: BT current reads 0 A, U104 BT_OK takes the 'no current' state, and the share loop loses its BT current feedback; the short current returns through the T9 Kelvin wire (3.44 mOhm), so the U104 reference bottom moves by < 0.1 mV
open_pair_consequences.detector: BT current plausibility (firmware); T-F-12 tap-to-tap check before power-up
